what: An instruction signed in the browser kept running after the browser was closed

stack.note: Started by this script; nothing else knows the port, so the interface connections the API reports are all there are.

instruction.document: Standing instruction Draft, not signed Buy Bitcoin in rupees with ₹200 from your bank account, every 2 minutes. two hundred rupees, each time. Not over ₹80,000 before 18 Feb 2027 Limits At most ₹200 in one run. At most ₹20,000 in one calendar month. Only if Only if the money is free in your bank account at that moment: what is left must still cover everything due before your income is certain to arrive. Only if your worst case stays at or above your floor after the purchase. Only at prices no more than 1.00% above the best price on the book, with price data no older than 15 seconds that agrees

steps.name: Live prices arrived on the isolated engine
steps.expected: fresh venue and independent prices for bitcoin within two minutes

steps.name: The instruction was signed through the interface
steps.expected: in force, approved with the password, bound to one document
steps.observed: instruction active, version 1; approved on the password entered minutes earlier to create the account; document 5166be13526e…

steps.name: A first run completed with the interface open
steps.expected: one run done; the API holds at least one interface connection
steps.observed: run due 2026-11-20 15:48:00.000 IST done; interface connections at the samples: 1

steps.name: Closing the browser closed every interface connection
steps.expected: the API reports none within ten seconds
steps.observed: none, 1 ms after the browser exited

steps.name: No interface was open at any point while away
steps.expected: zero interface connections at every sample for 12 minutes
steps.observed: 360 samples two seconds apart; 0 with a connection or no answer; engine reported running at 360

steps.name: Runs that fell due while away were executed by the engine alone
steps.expected: about 5 runs, two minutes apart, each done once, started when due, with no interface connected
steps.observed: 5 fell due: 5 done, none otherwise; started 889 ms after due at most; interface connections during them: 0

steps.name: Each of them was compared with the venue and has a receipt
steps.expected: reconciled, one receipt each, no occurrence twice
steps.observed: 5 reconciled, 5 receipts; 7 distinct occurrences for 7 runs; 7 distinct orders for 7 actions

steps.name: Back at the interface, the passbook shows what happened while away
steps.expected: 7 purchases listed, each attributed to the instruction
steps.observed: 7 purchase lines on the page; 7 runs done on record

steps.name: The books hold after it all
steps.expected: ledger consistent, receipts chained, books agree with the venue
steps.observed: ledger breaks 0; receipt chain intact (7); against the venue agrees

steps.name: The interface raised no error
steps.expected: no page error and no console error in either visit

notShown: The computer staying on: if it sleeps or is shut down the engine stops, and runs due in that time are recorded as missed and never executed late (evidence/20261120-overnight-sleep.json).
A hosted engine: this is one computer. Running the engine elsewhere is a production decision, not something shown here.
Real money: every order is a paper order against the live order book.
